snippet.title: Garden Haven - Trailer
snippet.description:
Garden Haven is a cozy mixed reality game for Meta Quest 3/3S. Using just your hands—no controllers!—you’ll plant, water, trim, and harvest flowers and veggies on your real furniture.

Guided by the adorable Garden Spirit, your garden grows as you care for it. Relaxing, family-friendly, and perfect for fans of Animal Crossing-style games—Garden Haven brings nature into your home, one sprout at a time. 

How will your garden grow? 
Wishlist if you like 🪴: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/garden-haven/27842597281997786/
